text:
tyler: Heads up — we're seeing a surge in traffic for payments during the 03:00 UTC window. Ops asked whether config-only fixes should auto-get a patch bump (x.y.z -> x.y.(z+1)) so deploybot can fast-track without manual review. Thoughts?

maria: if it's config-only and non-user-facing, i lean yes. but need guardrails (no schema changes, no new flags enabled by default).

mike-release: agree on guardrails. also we should never auto-bump during a customer-impacting rollout window. can we tie to release-window flag?

jess: what about pinning behavior? if someone pins to 1.4.2 explicitly, auto-bump shouldn't overwrite pin. deploybot should create 1.4.3 but not move pinned refs.

tyler: good call. requirement: respect pins. auto-bump only affects the candidate channel, not pinned tags.

mike-release: also need a log + audit note in the changelog: "config-only auto-patch" with PR id and author (even if bot closed). exportable for compliance.

deploy-bot: [action required] auto-patch policy check passed for change c/7890. Proposed: 1.4.2 -> 1.4.3 (config-only). Create tag and publish candidate image? Reply with `confirm` to proceed.

sre-oncall: quick Q — if rollback happens within 10m, do we auto-retire the new patch tag or leave it for postmortem?

maria: auto-retire sounds dangerous; prefer leave tag but mark with "rolled-back" metadata. we can add a `rollback=true` label.

jess: +1. then systems referencing tag won't silently flip; curation stays consistent.

mike-release: operational checklist draft: 1) ensure change is config-only 2) run smoke canary 3) wait 5m for errors 4) if >=1.5% error increase, rollback and label tag 5) create changelog entry with link to alerts.

tyler: can we add a soft hold for weekend surge windows? i.e., between 00:00-06:00 UTC avoid auto-bump unless `--force` with 2 approvals.

sre-oncall: yes please. weekends and our surge windows should require 2 approvals.

maria: implementation notes: in deploybot add endpoint `/auto-patch/evaluate` that returns {allowed: bool, reason: string, recommended_tag: string}. we can gate CI on it.

deploy-bot: ack — filed ticket INF-4123 to add evaluate endpoint. default policy: allow config-only auto-patch during normal hours, respect pins, add changelog, do not auto-retire tags on rollback (add label instead).

mike-release: thanks. can we also surface these policy decisions in the runbook and in the releasebot help text? new behavior needs visibility.

jess: i'll put a short note in release playbook and add FAQ entry.

tyler: perfect. last ask — how do we express the version increment rule clearly? i'd like: "config-only -> bump patch; infra-only -> bump patch; otherwise follow semver rules and require manual bump for minor/major."

maria: sounds good. we'll include examples in the doc: `1.2.3 + config change -> 1.2.4`; `1.2.3 + new public API -> 1.3.0`.

sre-oncall: closing note: monitor deploybot metrics next month to see noise from auto-patches. if false positives spike, revert policy.

tyler: thanks all. deploying policy start tomorrow.
